parts.name: Lid
parts.Basic_description: The lid of the kitchen pot is made of stainless steel, circular in shape, and fits snugly on top of the pot to cover it.
parts.Functional_description: It serves to retain heat and moisture during cooking, preventing spillage and speeding up the cooking process.
parts.Movement_description: It can be lifted or placed on the pot manually but remains stationary during cooking.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The base body of the kitchen pot is a cylindrical container made of stainless steel with handles on the sides.
parts.Functional_description: It holds food and liquids for cooking, providing the main volume for heat transfer and boiling.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary during use but can be lifted or moved by the handles when necessary.
